title: Creating a session is a small outline button at the far right of the bar; an empty home is just grey 'No sessions yet.'
where: /admin, AdminNav + AdminHome, 1440x900; empty state read from code
what_happens: The page's next step, New session, uses the quietest button style (xs outline, same as 'Back to sessions'), at the far right of the admin bar, away from where the eye starts. For a new organizer with no sessions the page body is only 'No sessions yet.' in small grey text (page.tsx:44), with nothing pointing to that button. The empty state was not seen in a browser: the test login has sessions; read from code.
who_hurts: A new organizer who just signed in (the sign-in page tells them 'Once you're in, you can create a new session') lands on an almost blank page and has to find the small button top right.
suggested_fix: In the empty state, put a New session link button under 'No sessions yet.' (src/app/admin/page.tsx:44). Optionally give the bar's New session the default Button look used for 'Send invites' / 'Create session' (admin-nav.tsx:29).
rule: general: clear next step; established pattern: primary actions elsewhere in admin use the filled Button
origin: earlier: #6/#9 (New session moved into the bar)
owners_call: Should an organizer with no sessions go straight to /admin/new instead of an empty list?
fingerprint: /admin|AdminHome empty state|clarity|new session hard to find
